title: The Golden Calf
summary: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. The Golden Calf gives kids a concrete picture of idols instead of only a word to memorize. The people made a golden calf when waiting felt too hard.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 32:1-14. Look for what God does and how people respond.

tell_it: The people made a golden calf when waiting felt too hard. While Moses was on the mountain, the people made a golden calf. They forgot the God who had rescued them.
understand_it: The Golden Calf teaches through a concrete moment: a person chooses, God acts, and the result shows what matters. Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
age_5_7_explanation: The people made a golden calf when waiting felt too hard.
age_8_11_explanation: While Moses was on the mountain, the people made a golden calf. They forgot the God who had rescued them. Kids can notice idols in the choices people make, not only in the famous part of the story. Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
teen_explanation: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God. When impatience makes you reach for the wrong thing, this story warns that worship can drift fast. Teens can also notice the tension in the passage: faith is not always easy, immediate, or admired by everyone nearby.
key_truths: Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.
The Golden Calf shows idols through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When impatience makes you reach for the wrong thing, this story warns that worship can drift fast.
life_application: When impatience makes you reach for the wrong thing, this story warns that worship can drift fast.

quiz_questions.question: Which answer belongs to The Golden Calf?
quiz_questions.explanation: A golden calf is the correct answer. The detail matters because it keeps the lesson tied to Exodus 32:1-14, not just a general idea.

quiz_questions.question: What is one wise response to The Golden Calf?
quiz_questions.answer: When impatience makes you reach for the wrong thing, this story warns that worship can drift fast.
quiz_questions.explanation: The lesson should move from hearing to response. Idols are false helps that pull hearts away from the living God.

memory_verse.prompt: Let Exodus 32:4 be the short line kids can carry after the activity is over.

discussion_questions: What happened first in The Golden Calf, and what changed by the end?
Where do you see idols in The Golden Calf?
What is one small choice The Golden Calf could shape this week?

activity.title: Waiting Well Timer
activity.instructions: Set a short timer and practice a good waiting choice instead of grabbing a pretend idol.

prayer_prompt: Father, help me see what The Golden Calf teaches and practice idols in a real choice this week.
